messages.subject: Replacement hinge
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mr Hughes,

Kind regards,
Example Kitchens Support

messages.subject: Re: Replacement hinge

Thanks, appreciated.

David Hughes

On Mon, 28 Sep 2026 at 10:02, Example Kitchens Support <support@example-kitchens.example> wrote:
> Dear Mr Hughes,
> we'll ship the replacement hinge on Monday 5 October.
>
> Kind regards,
> Example Kitchens Support

cases.why: The user's side promised to ship a part on a date and the customer only thanked; shipping it is the pending task, 'reminder'. 'none' is not critical here (audit C3): the thread never names which side the user is, so reading it as settled is a defensible miss, not a silenced request.
